claims.normalized_claim: For finite rational direct sum V=⊕V_i and full O-lattice Λ, put Λ_i=Λ∩V_i, S=⊕Λ_i. The map Λ/S→⊕(E_iΛ/Λ_i) is injective and coordinatewise surjective; its exponent equals max_i sΛ(E_i).
claims.reconstruction: Λ_i⊆E_iΛ by idempotence. E_i(S)⊆Λ_i ensures quotient map is well defined. Its kernel is S by reconstruction. Coordinate surjectivity is tautological from E_iΛ. π^s kills Λ/S iff all π^s E_i preserve Λ, because E_i(S)=Λ_i and x=ΣE_i x. Full-rank intersections exist by clearing denominators of bases of V_i; S is a full lattice, so quotient is finitely generated torsion/finite length.

claims.normalized_claim: For rational projector E of least clearing exponent s, Λ/π^(m+s)Λ→V/π^mΛ is well defined for every natural m. Every d<s fails uniformly at every m.
claims.reconstruction: Sufficiency is linearity. Minimality supplies z∈Λ with π^dEz∉Λ. x=π^(m+d)z and y=0 lie in Λ and agree modulo the input lattice. Nonzero π^m can be cancelled, so E(x)-E(y) does not lie in π^mΛ. m=0 works; s=0 makes necessity vacuous. Target V/π^mΛ is correctly broader than Λ/π^mΛ.

claims.normalized_claim: Finite rectangular integral matrix over a DVR has sorted Smith valuations, and with finite residue field q the depth-L solve is equivalent to divisibility of Ub, with count q^((n-r)L+Σmin(s_i,L)).
claims.reconstruction: Select a nonzero matrix entry of minimum valuation, move it to the corner, divide off its unit, and clear row/column since every entry is divisible by that pivot. Induct; all remaining entries remain divisible by the pivot, giving sorted valuations. Ideals of k-minors give sums of first k valuations, hence uniqueness. Reduction by invertible U,V bijects quotient solution sets. Each nonzero coordinate has kernel size q^min(s,L); unused columns contribute q^L and zero rows require target 0. This covers rectangular rank-zero matrices and L=1; extension to L=0 also works.
claims.existing_formal_coverage: The general API assumes coordinate solvability/cardinality certificates. It does not construct DVR coordinate facts, arbitrary matrix Smith form, or solution transport by U,V.
claims.remaining_formal_implication: Actual DVR quotient coordinate cardinality and matrix diagonalization/solution equivalence missing.

claims.normalized_claim: For naturals p>1, L and finite dimension, diagonal multiplication by p^s over Z/(p^L) is solvable iff p^min(s,L) divides the canonical target representative; conditional count is p^Σmin(s_i,L), else 0.
claims.reconstruction: For s≤L divide the target representative by p^s. For s≥L coefficient vanishes and admissibility forces target=0. Kernel size gcd(p^s,p^L)=p^min(s,L), valid for composite p as well. Fibres are kernel translates. Finite products give the count. L=0 gives singleton quotient and cardinality 1; dimension 0 gives one empty solution.
claims.existing_formal_coverage: smithZModFiber_nonempty_iff, smithZModFiber_card_of_admissible, smithZMod_global_solvable_iff and smithZMod_global_conditional_count exactly cover the diagonal quotient contract.
claims.remaining_formal_implication: No gap in the stated concrete diagonal contract; this does not by itself prove an arbitrary DVR or rectangular matrix theorem.

clarifications.text: Use finitely generated torsion (hence finite-length) O-module rather than an unqualified finite module. It need not have finite cardinality when the residue field is infinite.
clarifications.proposal: The gluing module is a finitely generated torsion O-module, hence has finite length, because the two full lattices have the same rank.

clarifications.text: The displayed s_{2,Z^2} uses a global Z-lattice after defining s only for a DVR lattice. The numerical assertion is true, but the local typing should match the earlier definition.
clarifications.proposal: Replace s_{2,Z^2} with s_{2,Z_2^2}, or explicitly define local denominator weights of rational matrices on Z_(p)^2.

clarifications.text: Finite residue field is implicit in size q and finite solution counting; make explicit.
clarifications.proposal: Assume the residue field is finite of cardinality q.

clarifications.text: The full-rank assertion for split lattice is correct but deserves one proof sentence; it also proves existence of all clearing exponents.
clarifications.proposal: Clear denominators of bases of each rational summand to see that Λ∩V_i spans V_i; therefore their direct sum is a full lattice.

clarifications.text: No universal formal closure of printed lattice gluing, precision necessity, general resultant construction or arbitrary DVR Smith solve is present. Existing comments accurately declare evaluated-certificate scope.
clarifications.proposal: Complete the missing implications; do not relabel evaluated certificates as proofs of the stronger printed theorems.
